evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm at the start of growth, consistent with the low post-purge baseline.
Oxygen rose to 17.1 ppm during growth, following readings of 6.3 and 10.7 ppm.
Oxygen continued rising through 22.2 and 26.2 ppm to 33.2 ppm despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature 750.5 C tracks the 750 C setpoint; heater power is stable at 45.4%, Ar is 99.2 sccm versus 100 commanded, and pressure remains near baseline at 760.1 Torr.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and a leak-integrity check are needed to distinguish air ingress from oxygen-sensor error or an internal oxygen source; sample characterization is not yet available.
